picks.detail: Capgemini’s ZF case describes a global RPA service. It is a relevant reference when several business units need a common operating model. In the RFP, ask which decisions the central team owns and which stay with a local process owner. Request one example of an automation rejected during discovery.

WeAreBrain describes automating supplier notifications and case updates for Truck Tyre Assist with ERP partner DooIT. Ask both who built the integration and who supports it. During evaluation, have the bidder trace a declined supplier request through reassignment and customer notification.

Slalom’s Genie case identifies the client, the support function and a rollout involving 180 agents. Ask the delivery lead which parts of a comparable bid cover training, queue configuration and post-launch support. Price those separately so a cheaper prototype is easy to spot alongside a fully staffed rollout.

methodology: The selection spans large consulting practices and smaller delivery teams with a public service description or case. Compare proposals against your own procurement requirements.
questions: Ask for named delivery leads, their allocation and any subcontracted work.
Request a reference in a similar operating environment. Ask the client what happened after go-live.
Require a sample statement of work with acceptance criteria, data handling and exit rights.
pricing: Ask for role-level rates, a milestone estimate and change-order terms. Normalize proposals to the same team size and time horizon before scoring cost.

firms.name: Accenture
firms.note: Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Check the scope and purchasing terms applicable to your organization.

firms.name: BCG
firms.note: Combines strategy and applied AI. Ask which operating decisions the first engagement would change.

firms.name: Capgemini
firms.note: Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask how the team handles process exceptions.

firms.name: Deloitte
firms.note: Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Ask how platform work and application delivery would be costed separately.

firms.name: IBM Consulting
firms.note: Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Ask for a design showing how existing applications and data will connect.

firms.name: McKinsey QuantumBlack
firms.note: Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Bring a decision that already has an accountable business owner.

firms.name: Slalom
firms.note: Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask who will build alongside your engineers and support the first release.

firms.name: AY Automate
firms.note: Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask who owns each integration after handover.

firms.name: WeAreBrain
firms.note: Offers workflow automation and integration. Bring a process that crosses two systems and ask how failed writes are reconciled.

firms.name: LowCode Agency
firms.note: Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. Ask for a walkthrough of the approval and exception paths.
